description: "The True Ministers of Christ Accredited by the Holy Spirit: A Sermon by Philip Gell" is a religious sermon published in the early 19th century, specifically in 1842. This work addresses themes of Christian ministry, the nature of true spiritual calling, and the role of the Holy Spirit in the lives of ministers.
